source_map.code_excerpt:
definition amount equals
    if age >= 18 then rate else 0
source_map.quote: Each person receives their own rate if their age is at least 18, and zero otherwise.

source_map.code_excerpt:
definition total equals
    sum integer of
      (map each person among people to
        (output of Entitlement with {
          -- age: person.age
          -- rate: person.rate
        }).amount)
source_map.quote: The household total is the sum of these separately computed entitlements over a complete list of people. Evaluate the entitlement rule separately for each person, using a reusable Entitlement scope. An empty household has zero total. Each item is a distinct person.
